description: Decided policy for every third-party program or runtime the three drivers depend on. docs/design/owned-runtimes.md renders its tables from these rows (tools/codegen/codegen-owned-runtimes.cjs) and tools/test/test-owned-runtimes-inventory.cjs fails when a program a driver starts is in no row's "programs".

PIN.label: PIN (own pinned copy)
PIN.meaning: Ship, or download on consent, our own pinned copy, verified by SHA-256, and run only that.

SYS.label: SYS (system tool: check, refuse clearly)
SYS.meaning: System tool: check its version at the point of use and refuse with a clear message. Never replaced, never modified.

OPT.label: OPT (optional feature)
OPT.meaning: Optional: a feature that uses it is hidden or inactive with a stated reason when it is absent; nothing else depends on it.

DELETE.label: Delete or remove (legacy path)
DELETE.meaning: A legacy path or probe that goes away.

NA.label: Not applicable
NA.meaning: Not used, or built by this repository.

PIN.meaning: Our own pinned copy is what runs today.

SHARED.meaning: Our pinned copy exists but shares a port, an extension or settings with the user's copy, or accepts theirs.

HOST.meaning: The host's or the user's copy is used today, at least in one format or path.

SYS.meaning: Used as a system tool today.

OPT.meaning: Used as an optional tool today.

NA.meaning: Not used, or built by this repository.

done.label: done
done.meaning: The code already behaves as decided.

follow_up.label: to do
follow_up.meaning: Decided; the code change is follow-up work.
